lineSemanticsProposal: LF-delimited physical rows; retain LF/CRLF/no terminator separately, do not trim body or normalize Unicode. A final LF terminates its last physical row, not a phantom extra line. A lone CR without LF remains text. EOL-only changes must remain visible separately from body +/- counts. This is proposed product presentation behavior, not a claim about the current helper.

cases.currentStaticCounterexample: Current message diffStats counts +2/-2 and paints a as removed and added. This is a source deduction, not an executed red.

construction.notation: Each numbered range denotes 1100 distinct one-line ASCII strings; not a literal ellipsis in input.

integrationExpectations.expected: Coordinates stay fragment-relative; no whole-file offset 500 inferred; equal fragment does not prove equal file.

integrationExpectations.case: Same supplied diff under failed/pending/unknown/completed tool status
integrationExpectations.expected: Text preserved in every state. Failed, unfinished and unknown stay distinct; completed report alone still is not current disk verification.
Retain source=write-input/edit-input and existing full-file/fragment scope; never promote it to official reported output or disk result.

integrationExpectations.case: One exact diff plus missing-before or fallback diff, including repeated paths
integrationExpectations.expected: Do not sum a precise-looking total across incomparable reports or call it net file changes; either scoped exact per-report stats or one clearly partial/unavailable summary.

integrationExpectations.case: Tool contains only diff.path and no locations
integrationExpectations.expected: Explicit path click uses existing MessageFileLink/onOpenFile verification once; render/search/expansion never triggers disk I/O. File failure keeps original reported text.

integrationExpectations.case: Collapsed long before/after content with distinct tail needles
integrationExpectations.expected: Both real tails remain findable through existing search expansion; generated range/status/precision labels excluded. Shared unchanged body is not double-painted or double-counted; no fake concatenated cross-line match.

integrationExpectations.case: Fragment side-by-side line selection and copy
integrationExpectations.expected: Real before/after coordinates and original bytes preserved. Diff-copy includes explicit precision/ending information or refuses misleading exact-patch output; copying raw before/after is exact.
